would_aggregation_change_v1: NO (no-edge rule; and the favourite was C03 in all six runs)

historical_aggregation_test.reason: A historical first-valid vs 3/5-call aggregate comparison needs 3-5 Jev calls on each of ~110 reconstructed historical states (~550 calls at ~35k input tokens each). That is not a proportionate research cost, and Jev does not affect V1 selection under the no-edge rule. Prospective replicate data exist for #2342 only (and will for #2343); on #2342 first-valid and aggregate favourites were identical (C03, which scored 2/6 on #2342: 13 and 33).
